 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile a 3x3 input in a 3x3 mirror-reflected pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * h):
        tile_r, local_r = divmod(r, h)
        src_r = h - 1 - local_r if tile_r != 1 else local_r
        row = []
        for c in range(3 * w):
            tile_c, local_c = divmod(c, w)
            src_c = w - 1 - local_c if tile_c != 1 else local_c
            row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
